auth.welcomeText: The future of dental practice management. Streamlined, efficient, and secure.
auth.subtitle: Enter your credentials to access your account.

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Verification
twoFactor.totpSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.otpSubtitle: Enter the code sent to your registered email.
twoFactor.backupSubtitle: Enter one of your saved backup codes.

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.disabledStatus: Not enabled — add an extra layer of security
twoFactor.scanQr: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.).
twoFactor.cantScan: Can't scan? Enter the secret manually in your app.
twoFactor.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your app
twoFactor.enterOtp: Enter the 6-digit code sent to your email
twoFactor.otpSentSetup: A verification code has been sent to your registered email address. Enter it below to confirm.
twoFactor.backupCodesWarning: Store these codes in a safe place. Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator. Without these, a lost authenticator cannot be recovered without admin intervention.
twoFactor.disableInstructions: To disable 2FA, re-enter your password and provide a current verification code.
